---
title: "Install"
---

## Prerequisites

Needed on the system: `wget`, `unzip`, `tar`, `gzip`, `xz`, `bzip2`, `gcc`, `g++`,
`gfortran`, `make`, `cmake`, `libxml2`.

Debian/Ubuntu:

```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install wget unzip tar gzip build-essential cmake gfortran \
  libxml2-dev libcrypt-dev libuv1-dev
```

Fedora:

```bash
sudo dnf install -y wget unzip tar gzip gcc gcc-c++ gcc-gfortran make cmake \
  libxml2-devel perl perl-core perl-CPAN
```

Optional, for R plots in X11 windows (local desktop):
`libx11-dev libxt-dev libxext-dev` (Fedora: `libX11-devel libXt-devel libXext-devel`).
Without them R is built without X11.

## Run

Start in an empty directory (not `$HOME`):

```bash
mkdir ~/hpc && cd ~/hpc
wget -qO- https://github.com/nucbio/hpc-setup/raw/main/boot.sh | bash
```

The build takes hours. On a laptop, prevent sleep first:

```bash
systemd-inhibit --what=sleep:idle bash
```

The log is written to `install.log`. If the run stops, see [Resume](resume.qmd).
